SPATHULATUM (Hornemann) Praeger, 1928 仙童唱
"spathulatum"意为"With a small spathe(暗示其勺形叶.)",已有中文名仙童唱.

©Alanca1
Synonyms :
异名:
Sempervivum spathulatum Hornemann (1819)
Sempervivum lineolare Haworth (1819)
Sempervivum barbatum C.Smith ex Otto (1820)
Sempervivum villosum Lindley (1832)
Aeonium cruentum Webb & Berthelot (1840) / Sempervivum cruentum (Webb & Berthelot) Webb ex Christ (1888) / Sempervivum spathulatum var. cruentum (Webb & Berthelot) Praeger (1929) / Sempervivum strepsicladum var. cruentum (Webb & Berthelot) Burchard (1929)
Aeonium strepsicladum Webb & Berthelot (1840) / Sempervivum strepsicladum (Webb & Berthelot) Webb ex Christ (1888) / Aldasorea strepsiclada (Webb & Berthelot) hort. ex Haage & Schmidt (1930)
Aichryson pulchellum C.A.Meyer (1842) / Sempervivum pulchellum (C.A.Meyer) Walpers (1843)
Aeonium bentejui Webb ex Christ (1888) / Sempervivum bentejui (Webb ex Christ) Christ (1888)
Section Chrysocome
克丽丝蔻(音译)组
Distribution : Canary Islands (Gran Canaria, Tenerife, Gomera, La Palma, Hierro); 250 - 2500 m.
分布:加那利群岛(大加那利岛,特内里费岛,戈梅拉岛,拉帕尔马岛,耶罗岛);250 - 2500m.
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003):
Perennial densely branched shrublets to 60 cm.
多年生密生灌木,成株可达60cm.
Branches 1 - 3 cm in diameter, puberulent, smooth, without reticulations.
枝干直径1 - 3cm,被微柔毛,光滑,无网纹.
Rosettes 1 - 5 cm in diameter, flattish to distinctly cup-shaped, inner leaves ± erect.
莲座直径1 - 5cm,明显呈杯形,内叶大致直立.
Leaves 0.5 - 2.5 x 0.3 – 0.9 cm, 1 - 1.5 mm thick, obovate-spatulate, apically obtuse, basally cuneate or attenuate, puberulent, lower face with conspicuous longitudinal brownish tannic stripes, margin with bead-shaped cilia (0.7 - 1 mm).
叶长0.5 - 2.5cm,宽0.3 - 0.9cm,厚1 - 1.5mm,倒卵状匙形,先端钝,基部楔形或渐狭,被微柔毛,叶背面具明显的褐色鞣酸纵条纹,叶缘有珠状纤毛(0.7 - 1mm) .
Inflorescences : Floriferous part lax, 3 - 10 x 3 - 15 cm, peduncle 5 - 20 cm, pedicel 1 - 10 mm, puberulent.
花序：松散花絮,高3 - 10cm,宽3 - 15cm,总花梗长5 - 20cm,花梗长1 - 10mm,被微柔毛.
Flowers 8- to 10-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 4.5 - 6 x 1.5 - 2 mm, elliptic, obtuse, yellow, often with reddish lines, filaments glabrous.
花基数8 - 10,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长4.5 - 6mm,宽1.5 - 2mm,椭圆形,钝,黄色,常带红色线条,花丝无毛.
Cytology : n=18
染色体:n=18
